what_happened: Found a sibling task (phase_commit_staging_has_no_scope_check) already landed with a converging Containment-vs-Overlap ruling at a different pipeline layer, giving directly reusable terminology (Containment predicate, drop-and-warn, fail OPEN) and a durable non-task-numbered anchor (general-implementation-agent.md's Phase-Commit Containment Self-Check heading) for this task's own header pointer requirement.

The existing 707_candidate excursion fixture in test-orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh feeds a modified_files entry that does not exist on disk, so it cannot distinguish pre-fix from post-fix staging behavior; it must be modified (real on-disk file + commit-contents assertion) to produce the fails-before/passes-after regression the acceptance criteria require, rather than supplemented with an unrelated new case.

The research report found that the existing 707_candidate excursion fixture asserts the PRE-fix behaviour as an invariant and cannot distinguish pre- from post-fix (its excursion path is never created on disk, so git-commit-scoped.sh's V2 unmatched-path tolerance already drops it). Planning turned that into a dedicated red-fixture phase (Phase 1) instead of a vacuous test, and all research line numbers re-derived cleanly against the live source store.

Task 335's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
